SET sqlite_all_varchar=true;
SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(g AS DOUBLE)) as max_g, MAX(TRY_CAST(r AS DOUBLE)) as max_r, MAX(TRY_CAST(h AS DOUBLE)) as max_h, MAX(TRY_CAST(hr AS DOUBLE)) as max_hr FROM baseball.main.batting

SET sqlite_all_varchar=true;
SELECT p.name_given, p.name_first, p.name_last, 
       TRY_CAST(b.g AS DOUBLE) as g, 
       TRY_CAST(b.r AS DOUBLE) as r, 
       TRY_CAST(b.h AS DOUBLE) as h, 
       TRY_CAST(b.hr AS DOUBLE) as hr,
       (TRY_CAST(b.g AS DOUBLE) + TRY_CAST(b.r AS DOUBLE) + TRY_CAST(b.h AS DOUBLE) + TRY_CAST(b.hr AS DOUBLE)) as total
FROM baseball.main.batting b
JOIN baseball.main.player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SET sqlite_all_varchar=true;
WITH max_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(TRY_CAST(g AS DOUBLE)) as max_g, 
    MAX(TRY_CAST(r AS DOUBLE)) as max_r, 
    MAX(TRY_CAST(h AS DOUBLE)) as max_h, 
    MAX(TRY_CAST(hr AS DOUBLE)) as max_hr 
  FROM baseball.main.batting
)
SELECT 'games played' as stat, p.name_given, TRY_CAST(b.g AS DOUBLE) as score
FROM baseball.main.batting b
JOIN baseball.main.player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
CROSS JOIN max_stats m
WHERE TRY_CAST(b.g AS DOUBLE) = m.max_g
UNION ALL
SELECT 'runs' as stat, p.name_given, TRY_CAST(b.r AS DOUBLE) as score
FROM baseball.main.batting b
JOIN baseball.main.player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
CROSS JOIN max_stats m
WHERE TRY_CAST(b.r AS DOUBLE) = m.max_r
UNION ALL
SELECT 'hits' as stat, p.name_given, TRY_CAST(b.h AS DOUBLE) as score
FROM baseball.main.batting b
JOIN baseball.main.player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
CROSS JOIN max_stats m
WHERE TRY_CAST(b.h AS DOUBLE) = m.max_h
UNION ALL
SELECT 'home runs' as stat, p.name_given, TRY_CAST(b.hr AS DOUBLE) as score
FROM baseball.main.batting b
JOIN baseball.main.player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
CROSS JOIN max_stats m
WHERE TRY_CAST(b.hr AS DOUBLE) = m.max_hr;
